book.name: Mɑɑku
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MAAKU U YORUA

content: Yesun seebu ɡɔrin di
Ye tɔ̃ɔ wɛ̃rɑruɡirɑ sɑrɑ, Mɑɑri Mɑdɑlɑɡii kɑ Sɑlomɛ kɑ Mɑɑri Yɑkɔbun mɛro, bɑ turɑre dwɑ bu kɑ Yesun ɡoru yɛ̃kɑ.
Ye n kuɑ ɑlusumɑ buun buru buru yellu kurɔ be, bɑ dɑ siki ten mi.
Swɑɑɔ bɑ bikiɑnɑmɔ, wɑrɑ u koo bu kpee te bimiɑ siki ten nɔɔn di.
Ye bɑ mɛɛrɑ mɑ bɑ wɑ, wee kpee te, tɑ bimiɑre bɑɑ mɛ tɑ kpɑ̃ too.
Ye bɑ duɑ siki te sɔɔ bɑ ɑluwɑɑsi ɡoo wɑ u sɔ̃ ben nɔm ɡeuɔ u yɑbe kpikiru sebuɑ. Mɑ bɛrum bu mwɑ ɡem ɡem.
U bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i ku bɛrum ko. Nɑ yɛ̃ mɑ Yesu Nɑsɑrɛtiɡiiwɑ i kɑsu wi bɑ kpɑre dɑ̃ɑ bunɑnɑru sɔɔ. U seewɑ ɡɔrin di u ǹ wɑ̃ɑ mini. I mɛɛrio mi bɑ rɑɑ nùn kpĩi.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, i doo i win bwɑ̃ɑbu sɔ̃ kɑ Piɛɛn tii mɑ u koo bu ɡbiiyɑ u dɑ Gɑlileɔ. Miyɑ bɑ koo nùn wɑ nɡe mɛ u rɑɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ.

Yerɑ bɑ yɑrimɑ bɑ duki doonɑ sikiru min di kɑ diiribu domi bɛrum bu mwɑ ɡem ɡem. Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ ɡoo ɡɑ̃ɑnu ɡɑnu sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɛrum sɑɑbu. Yesu u Mɑɑri Mɑdɑlɑɡii kure (I mɑɑ mɛɛrio Mɑteu 28:9-10, Yohɑnu 20:11-18) [
Ye Yesu u seewɑ ɡɔrin di ɑlusumɑ buun buru buru yellu, Mɑɑri Mɑdɑlɑɡiiwɑ u ɡbiɑ u tii sɔ̃ɔsi, wì sɔɔn di u wɛrɛkunu nɔɔbɑ yiru ɡirɑ.
Mɑ kurɔ wi, u dɑ u win kpɑɑsibu lɑbɑɑri ye sɔ̃ɔwɑ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnu kɑ swĩi sɔɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ nuɑ Yesu kuɑ wɑso, kurɔ wi mɑɑ nùn wɑ, bɑ ǹ ye wure.
Yesu u bwɑ̃ɑbu yiru kure
Yenin biru, Yesu u wiɡibu yiru ɡɑbu kure ye bɑ sĩimɔ swɑɑɔ bɑ bɑru kpɑɑru ɡɑru dɔɔ ɑdɑmɑ u tii kɔsɑ ben nɔni sɔɔ.
Ye bɑ wɔmɑ wuu min di bɑ be bɑ tie yen lɑbɑɑri sɔ̃ɔwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ bɑ ǹ mɑɑ ye nɑɑnɛ kue.
Yesu u tii bwɑ̃ɑbu
wɔkurɑ tiɑ ye sɔ̃ɔsi
Yen biru Yesu u bwɑ̃ɑbu wɔkurɑ tiɑ ye kuremɑ ye bɑ dimɔ. Mɑ u bu ɡerusi ben nɑɑnɛ dokebu sɑrirun sɔ̃ kɑ mɑɑ ben deɡɑnɡɑm sɔ̃, domi bɑ ǹ tɔn ben ɡɑri wure be bɑ nùn wɑ u seewɑ ɡɔrin di.
Mɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i doo hɑnduniɑn bɑɑmɑ kpuro kpɑ i bweseru bɑɑtere Lɑbɑɑri ɡeɑ wɑɑsu kuɑ.
Bɑɑwure wi u ye nɑɑnɛ doke, mɑ bɑ nùn bɑtɛmu kuɑ, u koo hunden fɑɑbɑ wɑ. Bɑɑwure wi u kun mɑɑ ye nɑɑnɛ doke, u koo tɑɑrɛ wɑ.
Sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡinu wee ni nɑɑnɛ dokeobu bɑ koo ko. Bɑ koo wɛrɛkunu ɡirɑ kɑ nɛn yĩsiru kpɑ bu kɑ bɑrum kpɑm ɡɑri ɡere.
Bɑ̀ n wɑɑ ɡɔsɔnu suɑ nɔmɑɔ, ǹ kun mɛ bɑ̀ n dɛ̃ɛ nɔrɑ, bɑ ǹ wɑhɑlɑ ɡɑɑ wɑsi. Bɑ̀ n mɑɑ bɑrɔbu nɔmu sɔndi, bɑ koo bɛkurɑwɑ.
Yesu u doonɔ Gusunɔn mi
Ye Yinni Yesu kɑ bu ɡɑri yi kuɑ u kpɑ, u suɑrɑ wɔllɔ u dɑ u sinɑ Gusunɔn nɔm ɡeuɔ.
Mɑ bwɑ̃ɑ be, bɑ dɑ bɑ wɑɑsu kuɑ bɑɑmɑ kpuro. Mɑ Yinni u kɑ bu sɔmbu te mɔ̀, u sɔ̃ɔsimɔ kɑ sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡinu mɑ ben ɡɑri sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡem.]
